items.text: Bobby Thomson of the New York Giants hit a game-winning home run in the bottom of the 9th inning off Brooklyn Dodgers pitcher Ralph Branca to win the National League pennant, the "Shot Heard 'Round the World".
items.question: Where were you when Bobby Thomson hit the Shot Heard 'Round the World, and who told you about it?
items.source_quote: "Shot Heard 'Round the World": One of the greatest moments in Major League Baseball history occurs when the New York Giants' Bobby Thomson hits a game winning home run in the bottom of the 9th inning off of Brooklyn Dodgers pitcher Ralph Branca, to win the National League pennant
